title: Open-RAG: Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Open-Source Large Language Models
authors: Shayekh Bin Islam; Md Asib Rahman; K S M Tozammel Hossain; Enamul Hoque; Shafiq Joty; Md Rizwan Parvez
